results.title: The Ghost and The Gun
results.overview: In 1948 Malaya, WWII vets Iz and Abe face vengeful ex-ally Chin Liu, who betrayed them during the war and now leads terrorists to their village. Haunted by past trauma, Iz must confront both his demons and Chin Liu's deadly advance.

results.title: Fanboy
results.overview: Fifteen-year-old Sem is a fan of YouTuber Wesley. When Sem accidentally films his idol's angry outburst, he uses the footage to blackmail himself into Wesley's life. His hope for a forced friendship with Wesley slowly but surely turns into something more sinister.
A bankrupt director in need of money to make a dream movie is trying to find her Alzheimer's mother who has just disappeared after promising to sell a house and divide her assets.

results.title: Maiin Haan
results.overview: Inspired by true events from 2007, Main Haan follows Seerat, a young woman haunted by an unseen presence after moving to Delhi. As terrifying incidents escalate, a shocking truth emerges—a restless spirit is using her to reveal an unfinished story connected to Sarab, the man she loves.

results.title: Balik Eskwela
results.overview: Based on a viral Tiktok story from Book of Bad Ideas. A student returns to school and finds herself responsible for saving another student from a serial killer, who only she knows.

results.title: Dead Net
results.overview: A promising young tennis player finds her dreams threatened when she is targeted by a mysterious figure who is out for her blood.

results.title: Whale Shark Jack
results.overview: Sarah, 12, lives on a boat with her parents, who research whale sharks. Her only friend is a whale shark named Jack, who Sarah rescued when he was a pup. But following a tragic accident, mum and Sarah move to the coastal town of Exmouth. Desperate to return to her old life, Sarah pegs all her hopes on Jack, certain that when his migration brings him back to Exmouth, mum will take her out on the boat again. But Jack fails to return, so Sarah embarks on a risky mission to find him.

results.title: Young Blood
results.overview: Three elderly men come across a bottle of magical beer. After experiencing their 'what-could-have-beens' in their 20-year-old bodies, they soon realize that second chances aren't needed when the first was more than enough.

results.title: Multwoh: Patay na Patay Sa'yo
results.overview: When a college queer dies suddenly in their dorm, they return as a ghost — not to seek revenge, but to say the one thing they never found the courage to say in life: "I love you".

results.title: The Barrel
results.overview: A young prankster wakes trapped in a metal barrel in an abandoned workshop. He must find a way out and learn how and why he got there. Estranged from his devout father, he can only rely on him, shackled to a pole nearby, for guidance.

results.title: Kurtág Fragments
results.overview: Renowned composer György Kurtág's journey through the key places and collaborations that shaped his work, capturing the transformation of emotions into music with world-class musicians in a cinematic exploration of his musical world.

results.title: Detective Brothers
results.overview: Operating a fidelity testing agency in Istanbul, a small team takes on a job to document a British diplomat's affair. However, what begins as a routine surveillance operation quickly plunges them into the crosshairs of an international intelligence conspiracy.

results.title: Stepmother
results.overview: A woman searching for love mistakes safety for home, and in doing so becomes entangled with a grieving daughter whose need for devotion turns survival into complicity.

results.title: Do Deewane Seher Mein
results.overview: Two socially awkward millennials in Mumbai find love while struggling with self-acceptance. As they battle insecurities and societal pressure, their journey takes them from city chaos to mountain serenity.

results.title: Bleachers - Live From The Stone Pony (YouTube Music Nights)
results.original_title: Bleachers - Live From The Stone Pony (YouTube Music Nights)
results.overview: The day after they released their fifth studio album, 'Everyone for Ten Minutes', Bleachers played a free show at The Stone Pony for 900 fans. Some flew across the country to be there, and others were locals who had been coming to see the band for over a decade. From the second they stepped onto that stage, it was one of their favourite shows ever. Thank god they filmed it.

results.title: U.V.F: Underground Video Films
results.overview: Presented as a forbidden TV broadcast, this horror anthology revives unsettling short films from the world.

results.title: Wild Nights, Tamed Beasts
results.overview: Delves into the realities of an aging society and centers on Ye Xiaolin – a former killer turned caregiver. She infiltrates and kills seniors under the guise of offering care, but her life takes an unexpected turn after a chance encounter with zookeeper Ma Deyong. As their fates become entangled and detective Zhou Ping begins to investigate the string of murders, a gripping story unfolds. The film raises awareness of aging-related societal issues by focusing on the themes of death, family dynamics, and the dignity of aging.

results.title: Hammerhead Sharks Up Close with Bertie Gregory
results.original_title: Hammerhead Sharks Up Close with Bertie Gregory
results.overview: In Mexico’s Pacific waters, Bertie Gregory goes in search of one of the ocean’s most iconic predators: the hammerhead shark. Once abundant in these seas, hammerhead numbers have plummeted, making sightings increasingly rare. Bertie investigates what’s driving the hammerhead decline, and how protected waters offer hope for the future. His journey culminates in a rare and unforgettable encounter that shines a light on the future of one of the world’s most famous sharks.

results.title: #Cult
results.overview: A group of young boys head to a party expecting a night of fun, but soon discover the reality is far darker than they imagined. What starts as excitement spirals into terror, pushing them into a brutal fight for survival.
